name: cotton
soil: Deep black cotton soil (Vertisols) or medium loam, pH 7.0–8.0

stages.name: Germination / Emergence
stages.irrigation: One pre-sowing irrigation. Avoid irrigation after sowing until seedlings emerge (7–10 days).
stages.fertilizer: Basal: 25 kg DAP + 15 kg MOP per acre. Seed treatment with Imidacloprid 70 WS.
tips: Plant spacing: 90 cm × 60 cm for Bt cotton
Sow Bt cotton with 20% non-Bt refuge crop

stages.name: Seedling / Early Vegetative
stages.fertilizer: Top dress 1: 20 kg Urea at 30 days after sowing.
tips: Yellow sticky traps help monitor and trap whitefly and thrips

stages.name: Squaring / Flower Bud Formation
stages.description: Square (flower buds) appear. Plant frame developing.
stages.irrigation: Irrigate every 10 days. Moisture stress at squaring reduces boll number.
stages.fertilizer: Top dress 2: 20 kg Urea + 10 kg MOP at 50–55 days.
watch_for: Pink bollworm attacking squares (entry hole visible)
Whitefly transmitting Cotton Leaf Curl Virus
tips: Install pheromone traps for bollworm monitoring
If Cotton Leaf Curl Virus seen, no cure — remove plants, control whitefly

stages.name: Flowering / Boll Formation
stages.description: White flowers appear, turning pink then falling. Bolls (cotton balls) form and grow.
stages.irrigation: Irrigate every 10–12 days. Critical period — moisture stress reduces boll size.
stages.fertilizer: Top dress 3: 15 kg Urea at 90 days. Foliar: 2% DAP spray at boll formation.
tips: This is the highest-value stage — protect bolls carefully

stages.name: Boll Maturation
stages.description: Bolls maturing and beginning to open (dehisce).
stages.irrigation: Reduce irrigation. Stop 3–4 weeks before final harvest.
tips: Ethephon spray (600 ml in 200 litres water) can hasten boll opening if needed

stages.name: Harvest
stages.description: Multiple pickings as bolls open over 4–8 weeks.
watch_for: Contamination of cotton with leaves or trash reduces price
tips: Pick only fully opened white bolls
Avoid picking in rain or wet conditions

common_pests.name: Pink Bollworm
common_pests.symptoms: Rosette flowers, pink larvae inside bolls, holes in seeds
common_pests.control: Chlorantraniliprole 0.3 ml/litre; pheromone traps for monitoring

common_pests.name: Whitefly
common_pests.symptoms: Yellowing, honeydew, sooty mould, transmits Cotton Leaf Curl Virus

common_pests.name: Thrips
common_pests.symptoms: Silvery leaf surface, curling of leaves upward

common_diseases.name: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV)
common_diseases.symptoms: Severe upward curling of leaves, dark vein thickening, stunted growth
common_diseases.control: No cure — control whitefly vector; remove infected plants

common_diseases.name: Fusarium Wilt
common_diseases.symptoms: Sudden wilting, yellowing, brown discoloration inside stem
common_diseases.control: Seed treatment with Trichoderma; soil application of Carbendazim 1 g/litre
